subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this fix only make event-triggered heartbeats honor configured heartbeat sessions, or should it also change Telegram's default DM session isolation away from the current `main` fallback?
rationale: The heartbeat.session precedence bug is a narrow existing-behavior fix, but changing default Telegram DM isolation can alter existing users' shared-session setups and needs explicit product/compatibility intent.

options.title: Fix heartbeat precedence first
options.body: Land a reviewed version of the heartbeat session-priority and event-migration fix, while leaving default Telegram DM isolation unchanged until a separate compatibility plan exists.

options.title: Change Telegram DM default too
options.body: Move default Telegram DMs to isolated session keys, but require doctor/docs/upgrade proof for users who relied on shared main sessions.

options.title: Document current setup only
options.body: Treat onboarding's `per-channel-peer` default as sufficient and leave existing explicit `main` configurations to opt into shared behavior, accepting the remaining edge cases.

recommendation.title: Fix heartbeat precedence first
recommendation.body: Land a reviewed version of the heartbeat session-priority and event-migration fix, while leaving default Telegram DM isolation unchanged until a separate compatibility plan exists.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected by history to both unified heartbeat behavior and routing/session defaults.
